title: Numbers / lines not showing on S20 Ultra
body:
### Subject of the issue
The large numbers and informational lines are none visible after new sensor

### Your environment
- Samsung S20 ultra
- Latest nightly 056b822-2020.12.18
- Android 11

### Expected behavior
Status lines and BG level to be visible 

### Actual behavior
No lines are visible

### Steps to reproduce the behavior:
Stop sensor, insert new, open app 

### Screenshots
![Screenshot_20201222-020923_xDrip+.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29239704/102840676-477a9400-43fb-11eb-84fe-985b5b4d4afa.jpg)

comments.body: Clearing Bluetooth cache and re calibrating resolved issue.
